description: Check a subcontractor's or vendor's certificate of insurance against the contract's insurance minimums on a given date. Send the policies as the ACORD 25 certificate shows them (type, effective and expiration dates, the limits in its boxes, the ADDL INSD, SUBR WVD and PER STATUTE marks, occurrence or claims-made, aggregate per policy, project or location) and the contract requirements per policy type (minimum limits and required marks). Get back pass or fail per requirement with the amount shown and required, policies not in force on the date, policies that expire within your warning window or before the work ends, and an overall verdict. Optionally lets the umbrella or excess limits count toward the general liability, auto and employer's liability minimums. No policy numbers, insurer or insured names are asked for. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/coi-requirements-check). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

as_of.description: Date to check coverage on (often the start of work), YYYY-MM-DD.

certificate.description: Policies on the certificate, one per type (up to 4).

aggregate_applies_per.description: GEN'L AGGREGATE LIMIT APPLIES PER box (general_liability).

combined_single_limit.description: COMBINED SINGLE LIMIT (Ea accident) shown on the certificate.

each_occurrence.description: EACH OCCURRENCE shown on the certificate.

el_disease_each_employee.description: E.L. DISEASE - EA EMPLOYEE shown on the certificate.

el_disease_policy_limit.description: E.L. DISEASE - POLICY LIMIT shown on the certificate.

el_each_accident.description: E.L. EACH ACCIDENT shown on the certificate.

general_aggregate.description: GENERAL AGGREGATE shown on the certificate.

products_completed_ops_aggregate.description: PRODUCTS - COMP/OP AGG shown on the certificate.

type.description: general_liability, auto_liability, umbrella_excess or workers_comp_el (one row each).

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'electrical sub, phase 2' (your own text, echoed; no names or policy numbers).

requirements.description: Contract minimums, one row per policy type (up to 4).

additional_insured.description: The contract requires additional insured status (ADDL INSD Y).

combined_single_limit.description: Minimum COMBINED SINGLE LIMIT (Ea accident) the contract requires.

each_occurrence.description: Minimum EACH OCCURRENCE the contract requires.

el_disease_each_employee.description: Minimum E.L. DISEASE - EA EMPLOYEE the contract requires.

el_disease_policy_limit.description: Minimum E.L. DISEASE - POLICY LIMIT the contract requires.

el_each_accident.description: Minimum E.L. EACH ACCIDENT the contract requires.

general_aggregate.description: Minimum GENERAL AGGREGATE the contract requires.

occurrence_required.description: The contract requires occurrence (not claims-made) coverage.

per_project_aggregate_required.description: The contract requires the general aggregate to apply per project.

per_statute.description: The contract requires statutory workers compensation (PER STATUTE).

products_completed_ops_aggregate.description: Minimum PRODUCTS - COMP/OP AGG the contract requires.

type.description: general_liability, auto_liability, umbrella_excess or workers_comp_el (one row each).

waiver_of_subrogation.description: The contract requires a waiver of subrogation (SUBR WVD Y).

umbrella_counts.description: true if the contract lets umbrella or excess limits make up a shortfall in the general liability, auto or employer's liability limits (default false).

warn_days.description: Flag policies expiring within this many days after as_of (default 30).

work_ends.description: Optional: the date the work or contract ends; policies expiring before it are flagged.
